rv.q: Four decades later, Swinton remains an electrifying presence.

cn.t: Swinton's magnetic return to the stage after 39 years earns universal praise, but critics split on whether Karge's gender-bending monologue still resonates today, resulting in mostly positive reviews with reservations about the play itself.
